# Throwaway test certificates

Self-signed PKCS#12 files made with OpenSSL only for `test_aeat_direct_backend`
(password `prueba-laideal`). They identify no one and are not accepted by AEAT:

- `test-client.p12` - valid for 20 years from October 2026
- `expired-client.p12` - expired in 2021

Never put a real certificate in the repository.
